The Shifting Spirit of Knowledge is a quest reward from A Rare and Unusual Spirit. It can be infused into one of the Wildseeds of Regrowth in the Queen's Conservatory in Ardenweald. When ready, Falir the Shifting can be released from the seed.

Shimmering Etherwyrms are etherwyrms located at a pond south of the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion.

Shimmersod is a faerie located in the Root Cellar of Ardenweald. A fan of illusions, Shimmersod has gotten himself so drunk that he's lost track of which of his four illusions is the real one. Mixy Mak knows Shimmersod, and realizes that he prefers animai tais.

__NOTOC__ Shinbone Slim is a Maldraxxi skeleton located in the Wrangler Pit in Maldraxxus.

Shimmerbough is an area of the Heart of the Forest. It is a waystation of the Path of Rebirth where faeries live currently being invaded by Drust led by Ingra Drif. Its name comes from the anima shimmering in the trees and water that occurs due to excess anima from the water pouring in from Tirna Achiad until the silt of the soil is glittering; Marasmius loved consuming it in his youth.

Shimmering Towers is a crystal-filled area in eastern Zaralek Cavern. The area is bordered by the Deepflayer Nest to the north, the Throughway to the east, Deephollow Lake to the south, Loamm to the southwest, and Glitterspore Lake and Acidbite Ravine to the west. The public objectives Crystalline Survey and Shellfire take place here, and the Shimmering Slalom dragonriding race starts at . The towers are occupied by Agitated Crystallines (during Crystalline Survey), Prismatic Snailettes, Scavenging Flayers, Slimy Whelks, Swooping Flayers, and Underlight Moths.

Shimmermaw Jr. is a hornswog found along with several Invasive Swoglets in the Hoard of Shimmermaw in the Forbidden Reach. Their home has been invaded by Mad-Eye Carrey, First Mate Ovdah and Navigator Bi-Yun.

A shop is a place, usually a building, that houses goods for sale along with vendors to sell them. Please note while inns and taverns may often have vendors that sell the same items that shops might, they themselves are not shops.

A shirt is a wearable item that has its own dedicated slot and does not have any functional purpose besides decorative appeal or bragging rights. Tailors can make a variety of shirts, but shirts can also be purchased from vendors, found as drops, or even received as quest rewards. A few shirts have personal value as parts of interesting sets of clothing, or as proof of obtaining a rare drop or completing a quest, but most are considered junk to non-roleplayers. Most shirts bind to the player once equipped and may be purchasable from vendors, other players, or from the Auction House. Sholazar Basin (pronounced SHOL-uh-zarh) is a tropical jungle basin in the midst of Northrend. It is found between Borean Tundra and Icecrown. The region's climate and safety from the Scourge is maintained by pylons, erected by the Titans. The whole history of Sholazar is that of a cradle of life, with at least some of the titan keepers taking an interest in the development of creatures great and small. During the war against the Lich King, one pylon in the east has fallen and the Scourge took this opportunity to invade from Icecrown to the north. In Sholazar Basin, adventurers can take part in a faction war between the wolvar Frenzyheart Tribe and the gorlocs, arctic cousins of murlocs. The
Shivsprocket's Shiv is a quest reward from The Perfect Poison which starts with Dirk Thunderwood at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Shoja'my is a jungle troll stable master located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of Escalation, she was caged by Kor'krons but soon released by the Darkspear Rebellion. She believed that the Horde cannot be taken from trolls. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, she was tending to a Dire Battlewolf.
Shore Crawlers are crabs found on the southwestern shores of Westfall.
A shock is a sudden effect, but is not limited to the classic electric shock. There are many different shocks in the game, all of them representing a certain element and damage caused by it.

Shirrak the Dead Watcher is the first boss of the Auchenai Crypts in Auchindoun. He is located at the end of the Bridge of Souls. Though he looks like an observer, he is actually an undead construct created by Exarch Maladaar.
__NOTOC__ Shleipnarr is a rare mob felsteed found in the eastern part of The Cauldron in the Searing Gorge.

This article is a list of short stories organized by source. There are 50 canon short stories in total (3 of Savage World category, 9 from Destination: Pandaria, 12 Leader Short Stories, 12 from Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth, and 14 others). Non-canon stories are also included in the list.

Shockadin is a sub-optimal talent spec for a Paladin which focuses on a more offensive Holy gameplay. As of patch 4.0.1 the spec has been made more solid with plenty of offensive talents being added to the Holy tree and quirks such as the removal of cooldown on Exorcism. Although not optimized for raiding, both healing and dps can be done fairly well in 5-man dungeons, even if PvP is where the spec truly shines.
Shipment to Nethergarde is provided as an objective for Deliver the Shipment.
The Shipment to Galvan is provided as an objective for The Formation of Felbane.
The Shipment of Rare Crystals is contained in the Unopened Crate in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Shlur is a female murloc and the senior shaman of the White Shark tribe. She is an old and crafty ruler and can silence even the proudest tiderunner with a single flick of her head-fin. Lilki is considered Shlur's successor and some whisper the young shaman not only wants her position but is unwilling to wait until Shlur dies naturally.
Shipment of Boots is contained in Drizzlik's Emporium in the Barrens

The Shiverwind Coast is the coast of the Dragonblight. It slopes northwards to the Dragonblight's single valley. Expert sailors can land small boats almost anywhere along it. Those with less experience or bigger boats land in Daggercap Bay instead. The human druid Mitrius spent two years on the coast, studying various plants and sea creatures. He was less than a day's travel from a murloc tribe on the coast.
The Shipment of Iron is located in the blacksmith building in Hillsbrad Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills.
Shivering Felspine is an epic polearm that drops off trash in Sunwell Plateau. It is slated as the #2 Seal of Blood retribution weapon in the game, and is also a strong choice for hunters.
Shiv of Exsanguination is an epic one-handed dagger best suited for rogues and hunters.
Shipping Schedule was pickpocketed from the Dockmaster in Elwynn Forest.

Shnel was a one-eyed forest troll belonging to Gree's tribe. He helped capture Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver, but died in a battle against hill dwarves — the rescuers of Vereesa and Falstad.

Shivering Healer's Cloak is a quest reward from: * It Was The Orcs, Honest! * The Sub-Chieftains

Shop Smart, Shop Pet...Smart is a Pet Battles achievement under Collect to obtain 50 unique companion pets. A short while after completing this achievement, Breanni sends you a Reeking Pet Carrier containing Stinker, another vanity pet, with a request to take care of him.
Shocking! (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Thaddius in Naxxramas without anyone in the raid crossing the negative and positive charges on 25-player mode.
Shockwave is a warrior class talent. It deals a small amount of damage and stuns all targets struck for 2 seconds in a point-blank area of effect cone.
Shore Crabs are crabs located on various shores around Azeroth.
Short Order Cook is an achievement that requires the character to learn 50 cooking recipes.

The Shooting Mechano-Tank is used to test the weapons system on the spider tanks. The rider is assigned to shoot the Mechano-Tank Attack Targets just across the hill from the tank. This tank looks much like the Scuttling Mechano-Tank, but with a gun affixed underneath the body.

Shipwreck Shore is the appropriately named beach shore on which the goblins wash ashore on the Lost Isles after the Alliance ships attacked Gallywix's Yacht carrying the Kezanian evacuees and slaves. The forward section of the ship has been made into a shelter. Several problems have arisen from the foliage to the north.

Shortblade Specialization is one of the racial traits granted to all gnome characters. It grants an expertise bonus while using One-Handed swords and daggers. When dual wielding different types of weapons, Shortblade Specialization is applied to each weapon individually, so that if you dual wield a One-Handed sword and an axe, only attacks made with the One-Handed sword benefit from Shortblade Specialization. When dual wielding two One-Handed swords, two daggers, or one One-Handed sword and one dagger, all of your attacks will benefit from Shortblade Specialization. The Shipyard Lumber is an objective of daily Tol Barad Peninsula quest Watch Out For Splinters! (Horde).

The Shores of the Well is a subzone of Well of Eternity. It is the shores of the Well of Eternity. Players are flown here on the back of a bronze drake. A road goes from a portal next to a small night elven house, to the encounter with Mannoroth and Varo'then, and then to a pair of towers at the burning outskirts of Zin-Azshari. As you arrive near the shores of the Well of Eternity, You see Illidan, Malfurion and Tyrande figuring out a plan to stop Mannoroth and Varo'then.
Shiro is a house cat located at Ella's farm in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Shipwrecked Crewmen are located at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.
Shiya Boldblade is a pandaren located in Shado-Li Basin in Kun-Lai Summit.

Shomi is a young pandaren living in Zouchin Village, on the remote northern shore of Kun-Lai Summit. She makes supply trips to One Keg, but otherwise stays within her quiet village. Her father, the town blacksmith, believes she should stay at home and learn to be a proper lady. Shomi believes she is not very good at being a lady, and might do better as an adventurer. She is out of town (presumably returning from a trip to One Keg) during the Zandalari attack on Zouchin Province. With the help of an outside adventurer, she learns to fight, helping to push the Zandalari out of the area. She can later be found teaching other villagers to fight. She uses a polearm in combat.

Shonuf is a yaungol that sought training at the Temple of the White Tiger, but was turned away. In retaliation, he sacked Yinying Village. He seems to consider himself the "master" of fireweaving. Considering that Yinying was sacked on his orders, he may lead the Yongqi tribe.

Shivertail's Mother is a frost wolf that lives with her family in a cavern just north of Wor'gol. She can be found protecting a group of Lost Pups from a Pale Tormentor. Once the tormentor is slain, she runs out of the cave to meet Shivertail, where the Lost Pups turn into Found Pups.

The Shoeshine Seat is a chair located next to Sheddle Glossgleam at Photonic Playground in Dalaran at Broken Isles or at Threads of Fate in Dalaran at Northrend Sit down for a moment, and the cobbler will bring a gleam to your footwear. This is also found next to Phil Gresham in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus where instead Sheddle, Phil will bring a gleam to your footwear.

Short-Beard and Long-Beard was a two headed ogre from the Gordunni in Feralas, recruited by Malus to be part of the group known as Gordok's Elite, to aid in his search for Aramar Thorne. They had skin the colour of a mottled peach, and both of their heads were bald and topped with a single, thick horn. They were nine feet tall, and each head also sported a beard, one short, and one long. Short-Beard was the head on the left, and Long-Beard was the head on the right. They wielded a couple of iron maces, one in each hand.
Shornai is a jinyu located in the Sand Bar in Zuldazar. He is seen speaking with Unakk.
Shipwrecked Soldiers are humans and dwarves located on the Broken Shore.
Shock Turrets are sentries located at the Abandoned Junkheap in Tiragarde Sound. Stay close for too long and get zapped.
__NOTOC__ Shore Saurid Matriarchs are saurid located in Nazmir.
The Short and Stout Brewery are an upstart brewery company from Brewnall Village who produced a mysterious new ale. They sent Sample Casks to Kharanos.

The Shirakess are a group of naga that have learned to harness the Void operating in Nazjatar.
